# SI041 — missing-reporter-rate-limit

Filing must limit open incidents per reporter.

## Why

Without a limit, one address can fill the public record with low-quality filings.

## Bad

```python
self.incidents[id] = incident  # no rate limit
```

## Good

```python
if open_count >= 10:
    raise Exception('REPORTER_RATE_LIMIT')
```

## Suppression

```python
# safetynet-disable-next-line SI041 -- reason
```
